{{verse|chapter=10|verse=29}}† Are not tvvo {{ls}}parovves {{ls}}old for a farthing: and not one of them {{ls}}hal fall vpon the ground vvithout your father? {{verse|chapter=10|verse=30}}† But your very heares of the head are al numbered. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=31}}† Feare not therfore: better are you then many {{ls}}parovves. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=32}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 8, 38. Luc 9, 26. 12, 8.''}}* Euery one therfore that {{ls}}hal {{sup|‖}} confe{{ls}}se me before men, I al{{ls}}o vvil confe{{ls}}se him before my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=33}}† But he that {{ls}}hal denie me before men, I al{{ls}}o vvil denie him before my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=34}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel vpō a Martyrs day that is not a Bi{{ls}}hop.}}Do not ye thinke {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 51.''}}* that I came to {{ls}}end peace into the earth: I came {{sup|‖}} not to {{ls}}end peace, but the {{ls}}word. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=35}}† For I came to {{ls}}eparate {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mich. 7, 6.''}}* man agayn{{ls}}t his father, and the daughter agayn{{ls}}t her mother, and the daughter in lavv agayn{{ls}}t her mother in lavv. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=36}}† And a mans enemies, they of his ovvne hou{{ls}}hold. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=37}}† He that loueth father or<noinclude>{{rh|||mother}}</noinclude>
